entries.story_title: Diplomatic push to end the US-Iran war
entries.claim_text: Iran's President Pezeshkian said Iran and Oman will sign an agreement Monday in Muscat on a joint shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, in the presence of Arab Gulf foreign ministers, with the IMO then notified.

entries.story_title: Diplomatic push to end the US-Iran war
entries.claim_text: Bahrain said it will not attend the Muscat meeting or any collective meeting involving Iran until diplomatic relations are restored (ties cut in January 2016).

entries.story_title: Diplomatic push to end the US-Iran war
entries.claim_text: Pezeshkian said Iran will reopen the Strait of Hormuz when the United States ends its naval blockade and attacks, adding Washington failed militarily and turned to economic pressure.

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: President Trump told reporters in Dublin that Iran was 'probably' behind the Thursday drone attack launched from Iraq that shut Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline (~5 mb/d to the Red Sea).

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: Trump said the Houthis called his administration saying they do not want the U.S. directly involved; the Islamic Resistance in Iraq denied responsibility for the pipeline attack, and Iraq closed some borders as a precaution.

entries.story_title: BRICS New Delhi summit and declaration
entries.claim_text: BRICS leaders unanimously adopted the New Delhi Declaration, expressing deep concern over Middle East escalation and urging maximum restraint through dialogue and diplomacy, without naming any country.

entries.story_title: BRICS New Delhi summit and declaration
entries.claim_text: On the BRICS summit sidelines, Pezeshkian met Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, a notable direct Iran-UAE contact despite opposing sides in the war.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Yemeni government forces announced they will deploy weapons and aircraft to retake areas seized in the Houthi lightning offensive, including the road to the port city of Mokha.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Satellite and open-source imagery show the Houthis mobilizing on Sept 12, days after capturing Mokha, Perim Island, Dhubab and the Hanish islands.
